title: Random-effects meta-analysis: REML with Hartung-Knapp
summary: The mean log odds ratio across trials with a REML estimate of between-trial variance, the Hartung-Knapp interval and a prediction interval.

sizing._why: A meta-analysis is not sized; its information size can be compared with the size a single adequate trial would need.

pinned_defaults: Log odds ratios with Woolf variances (escalc measure = 'OR'; no zero cells, so no continuity correction).

tau^2 by REML (convergence threshold 1e-12); the mean with the Hartung-Knapp interval (test = 'knha', t on k - 1 df); prediction interval; DerSimonian-Laird with a z interval beside it. Python maximizes the same restricted likelihood; statsmodels' combine_effects has no REML with Hartung-Knapp.
_read: Random effects estimate the MEAN of a distribution of true effects; report tau^2 and the prediction interval, which is usually much wider than the confidence interval.
